PM
Priya Mehta
UX Researcher • 10 hours ago
We ran a usability test on our new onboarding flow yesterday. 8 participants. 7 of them got stuck at the exact same step — the permissions screen. The copy said "Allow access to continue" and every single person read that as optional.

One word change: "Required to continue" — task completion went from 43% to 91%. Words matter. 📝
